table.retrieve:
SELECT	
	itemname= item.name, 
	accname = dbo.accounts.name, 
	aliasname = dbo.accounts.aliasname, 
	address = dbo.customer.address1,
	salesman = dbo.users.username, 
	patientregno = (SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = dbo.srbufferledger.PatientCode),
	patientname = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = dbo.srbufferledger.PatientCode),
	srbufferinvcode = dbo.srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode,   
	saleinvcode = dbo.srbufferledger.saleinvcode,   
	date = dbo.srbufferledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.srbufferledger.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.srbufferledger.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.srbufferledger.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.srbufferledger.salestax,   
	dbo.srbufferledger.custcode, 
	gcode = srbufferdetail.gcode,   
	icode = srbufferdetail.icode,   
	batch = srbufferdetail.batch,   
	expiry = srbufferdetail.expiry,   
	looseqty = srbufferdetail.looseqty,
	packqty  = srbufferdetail.packqty,
	bonusqty = srbufferdetail.bonusqty,
	packunits= srbufferdetail.packunits,
	saleprice= srbufferdetail.srprice,
	discperc = srbufferdetail.discperc,
	salestax = srbufferdetail.salestax ,
	unitsalestax=srbufferdetail.unitsalestax,
	itemgstperc=srbufferdetail.gstperc,
	invgstperc=srbufferledger.invgstperc1,
	remarks=srbufferledger.remarks,
	headerno = srbufferledger.headerno,
	headerinvno = srbufferledger.headerinvNo
FROM 
	srbufferledger, 
	srbufferdetail, 
	accounts, 
	customer,
	users, 
	item  
WHERE 
	( dbo.srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode = :ar_srbufferinvcode ) AND
	( dbo.srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode = dbo.srbufferdetail.srbufferinvcode) AND
	( dbo.srbufferledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.srbufferledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND 
	( dbo.srbufferdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: sum(Round(( looseqty *   saleprice ) *  ( discperc *  .01 ) , 2) for all)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) , 2)

objects.name: c_totalsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round( (sum (c_amount for all) * 0.01 * discperc) * ( 1 -  flatdisc ) * (invgstperc  *  0.01) ,2)  + Round(sum( c_salestaxval for all) ,0)

objects.name: compute_2
objects.expression: Round( (Round( sum (c_amount for all) * (1 - 0.01 *  discperc ) ,2) -  flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc  ,2 )

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(sum( c_amount ) * (1 -   invdiscperc   * .01) -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  salestax , 0)  + Round(Round( (Round( sum (c_amount for all) * (1 - 0.01 *  discperc ) ,2) -  flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc  ,2 )  + sum( c_salestaxval for all) ,0)

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: Round((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   * (bonusqty + looseqty) ) , 2)
